description.value: Fuel Hut is a Canadian family-owned smoothie, supplement, and snacks shop operating on the second level inside New Westminster SkyTrain Station, an extension of the adjacent Dynamic Health and Fitness centre. It specializes in no-sugar-added smoothies built from organic fruits, vegetables, and performance superfoods, alongside wraps and a range of nutritional supplements. Cyclists passing through New Westminster's busy transit hub will find a convenient spot for a high-protein, whole-food refuel.
